Even a journalist doesn't think AI will make them more productive it's probably worthwhile to use it (especially the less superficial use cases) to understand more about how the technology works.


rat king 🐀 (@MikeIsaac)

universal statements like these are so telling

motherfucker i am not using it to do something ive done every day for 30 years, but i guess you are!

Not my favorite meme but there is a certain cohort of rich dudes who run for office when they should be going to therapy.

Well it might be how she behaved if she were desperately trying to hang on to her family's fading grip on power. She was either lying then or now, but there was more at stake then.


Alex Thompson (@AlexThomp)

A lot of Democrats including several former Biden aides I talked to just simply don't believe Jill Biden.

Given how she behaved post-debate, several Biden aides said that if she really believed he was having a stroke, that's not how she would act. 
Talking w/ @brikeilarcnn

Video

I didn't want to let Paxton's massive win in the Texas runoff pass by without doing some reflection on the status of the Republican Party. So here's an attempt at a scorecard for grading party health.

I'm personally excited about the World Cup but there is a *lot* of ticket inventory for the group stage (like literallly 5m tickets to sell) without a lot of premium matchups.  I don't think anyone should be in a rush to buy tix. Knockout stage and USA/MEX/CAN matches maybe.

OK, with the Knicks, Spurs and Thunder making every other team feel insecure, let's lean into that Carlos Boozer vs AJ debate.

Via Joseph George (@jogeor_), here's how we think the NBA lottery *should* go. 

This probably isn't how it *will* go.

natesilver.net/p/nba-lottery…
Not sure there's a great precedent for this Knicks playoff run? With young teams, sort of. But a veteran team just waking up one day and playing like the '96 Bulls for 11 games and running?

I find this pretty common. Opus is like "should I take a shortcut or be more rigorous?" and recommends taking a shortcut when the only cost to being more rigorous is that it has to write a few extra lines of code.

I'm trying to avoid too much confrontation on Twitter these days but it's probably worth asking yourself whether these testimonials to Newsom's electability come from people who thought Kamala Harris and the 2024 version of Joe Biden were strong candidates.

The redistricting thing was smart by Newsom, and consequential, there's just no particular evidence that he swung the polls much on it as it was popular in a very blue state pretty much from the moment that voters were aware of what the ballot initiative did.


Neera Tanden🌻 (@neeratanden)

Politics is about making an argument - and Newsom just moved California 20 points on the redistricting initiative, an initiative that was running behind or even, depending on the poll,  when it started.  News
Well, either the Knicks are going to the Finals or this is gonna be an S-Tier setup for a future "30 for 30".
